Metadata.title: Velinova — Digital employees for your business
Metadata.description: Velinova deploys AI agents that qualify your leads, answer your customers, and handle your admin work, around the clock.

Hero.title: Hire digital employees, not scripts.
Hero.subtitle: Velinova deploys AI agents that qualify your leads, answer your customers, and handle your admin work — no hiring, no breaks, no fatigue-driven mistakes.

Problem.title: Your teams spend more time processing than selling.
Problem.description: Qualifying a lead, answering a support question, booking a meeting: necessary work, rarely strategic, and it piles up faster than your teams can clear it.

points.title: Leads lost overnight
points.description: A lead that doesn't get a response within 5 minutes is far less likely to convert. Your sales reps aren't working around the clock.

points.title: An overloaded support team
points.description: The same questions come up dozens of times a day, tying up human time on repetitive, low-value answers.

points.title: Classic automation hits a wall
points.description: Scripts and chatbots follow a fixed path: the moment a situation falls outside it, they stall and hand the problem to a human.

Solution.title: A Velinova agent doesn't run a script. It does the work.
Solution.description: Unlike classic automation, our agents understand context, make decisions, and adapt to every conversation — the way a trained employee would, available around the clock.

Agents.name: Emma
Agents.description: Engages every prospect in under a minute, asks the right questions, and passes only qualified leads to your sales reps.

Agents.name: Lucas
Agents.description: Answers customer questions around the clock, resolves common requests, and escalates complex cases to a human.

Agents.name: Sofia
Agents.description: Offers time slots, handles confirmations and reminders, and syncs directly with your calendars.

Agents.name: Marc
Agents.description: Handles data entry, repetitive documents, and the follow-up tasks that slow your teams down.

items.challenge: 70% of inbound requests arrived outside business hours and went unanswered until the next day.
items.solution: A Velinova agent qualifies every request, sends matching listings, and offers a viewing.
items.result: First response time: from 14 hours to 90 seconds.

items.challenge: Sales reps lost a third of their week sorting through mostly unqualified inbound leads.
items.solution: A Velinova agent filters and scores every lead before routing it to the right rep.

items.challenge: The support team handled over 200 tickets a day, 80% of them recurring order questions.
items.solution: A Velinova agent answers common questions instantly and escalates edge cases.

steps.title: We map your tasks
steps.description: A quick audit identifies the high-volume repetitive tasks across your sales, support, or admin teams.

steps.title: We configure your agent
steps.description: The agent is trained on your process, your tone, and your existing tools — CRM, calendar, inbox, helpdesk.

steps.title: It joins your team
steps.description: The agent goes live around the clock, with continuous reporting and regular tuning based on your feedback.

items.title: Time saved
items.description: Your teams refocus on high-value work while the agent handles the volume.

items.title: Lower costs
items.description: One agent handles a volume of requests equivalent to several full-time roles, at a fraction of the cost.

items.title: More sales
items.description: Every lead is handled within seconds, day and night, which directly improves your conversion rate.

items.title: 24/7 availability
items.description: No nights, no weekends, no time off: your customers get an answer at any hour.

items.title: Simple integration
items.description: Connects directly to your existing tools — CRM, calendar, helpdesk — without changing your process.
